name: io.github.tonyyang0504/falabella-mcp
description: Falabella Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, update_listing, set_inventory, end_list

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Seller Center API key (Mi Cuenta > Integraciones / API in Falabella Seller Center). Signs every request (HMAC-SHA256 hex over the name-sorted, RFC 3986-encoded query, sent as the Signature parameter); never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Seller Center UserID: the e-mail login the API key belongs to (sent as UserID).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_OPERATOR_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Business unit to write to: facl (Chile), fape (Peru) or faco (Colombia).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_FALABELLA_WAREHOUSE_ID
environmentVariables.description: SellerWarehouseId for set_inventory when the seller has several warehouses (GetWarehouse); leave empty with a single warehouse.
